families.units: Milliseconds per RPC attempt; remaining Provider deadlines are absolute milliseconds supplied by the caller.
families.unset_zero: Only undefined selects each method default. Fixed overrides require canonical positive decimal safe integers <=2147483647; empty, zero, leading zero, fractional, signed and oversized values reject. Every supplied override for a remaining_provider_budget method rejects.
families.constraints: Exactly 37 fixed and 3 remaining_provider_budget methods. registerRuntimeProcess/reportRuntimeProcess use the Runtime alias keys. Short-write defaults import SessionEventWriterRetryPolicy.timeoutPerAttemptMs (3000); its separate 3 attempts and 100/300 ms backoffs retain their existing retry authority. Method policies authorize no retries. Fixed deadlines clip to a shorter caller phase/Provider deadline; remaining-provider methods require a finite caller deadline and cannot reset it. Runtime startup also requires report timeout<report interval<process freshness.
families.projection: Runtime startup parses these supported application env overrides. No dedicated Helm per-method override knobs: service/raw/Helm Runtime defaults retain the owner policies. The checked bridge-method-policy.json mirror enumerates RPC routes; internal-routing.yaml disables proxy timeout and retries for every Bridge method, so the proxy cannot shorten application overrides. Existing transport tests check the descriptor mirror and proxy disposition; configuration_projection_test.go checks this complete catalog against actual owner exports/key derivation.
